problems.quote: which is the obverse of “All managers are engineers”
problems.problem: “No non‑engineers are managers” is not the obverse of “All managers are engineers”; it is the converse of the obverse.
problems.correction: which is the converse of the obverse of “All managers are engineers”
problems.verifierReason: Original misidentifies converse of obverse as obverse; correction accurately describes it as converse of obverse.

problems.quote: is the contrapositive of “Some teachers are not students”
problems.problem: The contrapositive of “Some teachers are not students” is “Some non‑students are not non‑teachers”, not “Some non‑students are not teachers”.
problems.correction: is not the contrapositive of “Some teachers are not students”
problems.verifierReason: Original falsely claims a statement is contrapositive; correction correctly negates that claim.
